title: Installation of the Aft Cargo Compartment Ceiling and Sidewall Lining Panels
abstract: Installation of the ceiling and sidewall lining panels in the aft cargo compartment, restoring the fire containment boundary and verifying the smoke detection sampling path before the compartment is returned to service.

sections.purpose: This task installs the ceiling and sidewall lining panels in the aft cargo compartment, restores the certified fire containment boundary and verifies the smoke detection response before the compartment is released for loading.
sections.job_setup_note: Every panel must return to the position recorded at removal. Check each panel for cracking at the latch cut-outs before you fit it; a cracked panel is not a containment boundary. Confirm the insulation blanket standard before you close the ceiling, because a thicker blanket changes the panel standoff and needs the deeper bracket.
sections.procedure: 1. Confirm from the accountability sheet that every panel is present and matched to its position. 2. Inspect each panel for cracking at the latch cut-outs and for delamination at the edges. CAUTION: A PANEL WITH A CRACK THROUGH A LATCH CUT-OUT IS NOT A CONTAINMENT BOUNDARY. REPLACE IT WITH A CERTIFIED ITEM. 3. Confirm the insulation blanket standard and select the matching standoff bracket. 4. Install the sidewall panels and the restraint decor panel D2550136675057. 5. Reconnect the lighting kit D2550118482429 at each ceiling position. 6. Raise the ceiling panels one at a time and engage the latches D2550114658909, working from the forward end aft. 7. Confirm that every latch is fully engaged and that no gap exceeds the limit at any panel joint. WARNING: A GAP LARGER THAN THE LIMIT WILL LET SMOKE BYPASS THE SAMPLING PORT AND DELAY DETECTION. MEASURE EVERY JOINT. 8. Confirm that the monument fitting D2550007584379 is secure and that the panel at FIN 6DL is correctly located. 9. Restore the cargo lighting and confirm operation at every position including the light at FIN 3596DQ. 10. Restore the smoke detection system and do the detection functional test with the test aerosol. 11. Confirm that the latch at FIN 76DL is engaged and locked.
sections.close_out: Remove the warning notices and confirm that the smoke detection system is active. Confirm that the accountability sheet is complete and signed. Record the panel positions, any panel replaced and the smoke detection test result against the aircraft. Release the compartment for loading only after a satisfactory detection test.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft; the deeper standoff bracket applies to aircraft with the upgraded acoustic blanket

safety_precautions: Do not release the compartment for loading before a satisfactory detection test.
Support every panel until the latches are engaged.
Isolate the cargo lighting while you make the connections.
Use the test aerosol only in a ventilated compartment.
